description: This file defines the Supergateway_MCP class implementing the INode interface, which manages MCP server tools, including loading available actions, initializing tools based on arguments, and integrating with MCPToolkit and validation functions.

classes.name: Supergateway_MCP
classes.description: A class implementing INode that manages MCP server tools, including listing actions, initializing tools, and handling arguments and validation.

methods.name: loadMethods
methods.description: Contains method listActions to asynchronously list available MCP actions, sorted by name, or return an error message if failed.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes tools based on nodeData inputs, parsing mcpActions and filtering tools accordingly.

methods.name: getTools
methods.description: Generates server parameters from arguments, performs security validation, initializes MCPToolkit, and returns available tools.
